newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Ecopetrol slashes fuel thefts.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Ecopetrol slashes fuel thefts.

text.p: Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol said Sunday it had slashed the theft of gasoline and other fuel from its pipelines and installations.
Thefts, which it blamed on organized criminal gangs, were running at 420,000 barrels, worth $8.3 million, in 1994 but were cut to 87,000 barrels, valued at $2.7 million last year, Ecopetrol said.
In the first four months of this year 15,000 barrels of gasoline and other fuel, worth about $400,000, have been stolen.
The Ecopetrol statement said security had been stepped up and automatic surveillance systems had been beefed up to prevent the gangs piercing pipelines to siphon off the fuel.
